title: heliophila pusilla var. lanceolata
intro: Heliophila pusilla var. lanceolata, commonly known as Dwarf Namaqualand Button Flower, is a plant species within the family Brassicaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a promising remedy for skin issues and infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of Heliophila pusilla var. lanceolata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
